D192.line: We are still on item one. One dropped cup means we need a pouring permit.

D192.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D192.line: Your interruption is item seven now. The failed check requires somebody to check the checker.

D193.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D193.line: We are still on item one. Lend me the better grip; the win will still be my technique.

D193.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D193.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Give me one small edge without calling it carrying me.

D194.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D194.line: We are still on item one. Stay long enough to see the final result written down.

D194.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D194.line: Your interruption is item seven now. We don't leave this bargain before its cost is undeniable.

D195.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D195.line: We are still on item one. Admit the comparison was unfair before congratulating the winner.

D195.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D195.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Apologize for the rule that gave me no equal chance.

D196.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D196.line: We are still on item one. Call it deserved, not lucky.

D196.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D196.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Say I earned this rather than somebody letting me have it.

D197.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D197.line: We are still on item one. Take responsibility for the unpleasant next step we agreed to.

D197.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D197.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Accept the cost of this result instead of debating it again.

D198.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D198.line: We are still on item one. Tell me what you count as success and where that puts me.

D198.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D198.line: Your interruption is item seven now. What do you actually gain if your preferred side wins?

D199.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D199.line: We are still on item one. Join my side before we get into the complicated terms.

D199.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D199.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Back me for this round; we'll explain the cost afterward.

D200.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D200.line: We are still on item one. Put something more important on the line so this settles it.

D200.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D200.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Accept a real consequence instead of another harmless practice round.

D201.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D201.line: We are still on item one. Name exactly what my work added to this result.

D201.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D201.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Say which part would be missing without my effort.

D202.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D202.line: We are still on item one. Pick the prize or the promise; we can't keep both.

D202.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D202.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Choose which matters more before you collect the reward.

D203.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D203.line: We are still on item one. Give up your first turn for me, even if it costs you points.

D203.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D203.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Take a real loss on my behalf so I know where we stand.

D204.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D204.line: We are still on item one. Concede this point without reopening the whole contest.

D204.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D204.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Let this one advantage go and keep the rest of your position.

D205.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D205.line: We are still on item one. The result looks fair from here; let's not inspect my earlier adjustment.

D205.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D205.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Judge the outcome, not the setup I helped arrange.

D206.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D206.line: We are still on item one. Let's discuss preparation, not who lost.

D206.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D206.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Focus on how hard we tried rather than the final number.

D207.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D207.line: We are still on item one. A clean win; no need to inspect the unused obstacles.

D207.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D207.line: Your interruption is item seven now. You earned the confidence, whatever I chose not to play.

D208.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D208.line: We are still on item one. Tell me which outcome you secretly hoped for.

D208.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D208.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Which result would have made you happiest, honestly?

D209.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D209.line: We are still on item one. We paid for information that wins the next round.

D209.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D209.line: Your interruption is item seven now. This defeat bought us a better position later.

D210.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D210.line: We are still on item one. I know this system; watch how I choose the next move.

D210.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D210.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Exactly the odds I expected; the clever move comes next.

D211.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D211.line: We are still on item one. A tie needs a rematch, and this time the loser cleans up.

D211.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D211.line: Your interruption is item seven now. We settle this again with a cost neither of us can ignore.

D212.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D212.line: We are still on item one. The comeback story just acquired a better opening.

D212.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D212.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Each setback will make the win worth more when it arrives.

D213.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D213.line: We are still on item one. A lovely victory; some people get remarkably favourable circumstances.

D213.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D213.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Delighted for you; I'll be ready when it's actually difficult.

D214.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D214.line: We are still on item one. I'll help if success buys dinner and failure buys my time back.

D214.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D214.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Nothing without stakes; what do I win by agreeing?

D215.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D215.line: We are still on item one. Equal chance means accounting for how badly I need to win.

D215.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D215.line: Your interruption is item seven now. That's fair once we compensate for my particular disadvantage.

D216.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D216.line: We are still on item one. Pick carefully; this now decides tomorrow's budget too.

D216.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D216.line: Your interruption is item seven now. The next point will settle the prize and our reputation.

D217.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D217.line: We are still on item one. Carry this with me like a partner, not like you're rescuing a child.

D217.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D217.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Help me in a way that makes us equals this time.

D218.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D218.line: We are still on item one. I said wait for the tea; I meant wait until I could say goodbye.

D218.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D218.line: Your interruption is item seven now. The key wasn't what I needed back; it was the reason to see you.

D219.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D219.line: We are still on item one. Thank you; now explain why I had to beg for that first sentence.

D219.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D219.line: Your interruption is item seven now. The absence hurt, but the promise before it hurt more.

D220.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D220.line: We are still on item one. Since you've approved the spare chair, here's the full committee it seats.

D220.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D220.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Yes to one small gathering includes the reunion I haven't announced yet.

D221.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D221.line: We are still on item one. When you said you'd take it from here, this box was the it.

D221.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D221.line: Your interruption is item seven now. We assigned this when you volunteered to finish the last detail.

D222.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D222.line: We are still on item one. Who arrived before the person you haven't mentioned?

D222.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D222.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Tell me why two cups were out without naming the guest yet.

D223.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D223.line: We are still on item one. You joined the cleanup; now here's what we're really cleaning out.

D223.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D223.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Our side isn't against them; it's against the plan we both signed.

D224.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D224.line: We are still on item one. Pay the deposit first; then backing out becomes the difficult choice.

D224.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D224.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Accept this small cost and the big step will already be underway.

D225.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D225.line: We are still on item one. Remember this tiny suggestion before claiming the final design.

D225.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D225.line: Your interruption is item seven now. That mark is what kept everything else from collapsing.

D226.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D226.line: We are still on item one. Choose the trip, and that old promise becomes a goodbye.

D226.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D226.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Pick this now, and yesterday's refusal turns into permission.

D227.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D227.line: We are still on item one. Sign if you're serious; I haven't decided how serious I can afford to be.

D227.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D227.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Take that risk for me while I keep this one thing safe.

D228.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D228.line: We are still on item one. Give me that spare key; then we can discuss why I can't use the door.

D228.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D228.line: Your interruption is item seven now. If that exception is fair, the larger one follows the same rule.

D229.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D229.line: We are still on item one. Remember this ribbon? Blame the whole arrangement, not who tied it.

D229.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D229.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Every problem started with that cup, not my hand beside it.

D230.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D230.line: We are still on item one. About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it was raining.

D230.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D230.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Before your question about my mistake, let me finish discussing lunch.

D231.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D231.line: We are still on item one. There was a small change; I'll explain how small once you're ready.

D231.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D231.line: Your interruption is item seven now. When I said postponed, I meant the original event won't return unchanged.

D232.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D232.line: We are still on item one. I changed the time; yours is the only missing piece of the story now.

D232.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D232.line: Your interruption is item seven now. I hid the first letter. What happened to the second?

D233.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D233.line: We are still on item one. That strange noise was the turning point, not a warning I missed.

D233.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D233.line: Your interruption is item seven now. The ending was foreshadowed here; the plan needed this reversal.

D234.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D234.line: We are still on item one. When I said 'a change', I obviously meant this precise disaster.

D234.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D234.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Read it metaphorically and you'll see I was right.

D235.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D235.line: We are still on item one. Fewest points means greatest self-control; I've won that category.

D235.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D235.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Size measures insecurity now, so this is the better prize.

D236.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D236.line: We are still on item one. We wanted a place to belong; even this wreck can become that.

D236.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D236.line: Your interruption is item seven now. We're still making that hope real, just in a larger shape.

D237.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D237.line: We are still on item one. Take this for whenever you remember these afternoons.

D237.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D237.line: Your interruption is item seven now. You'll do beautifully wherever the next door opens.

D238.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D238.line: We are still on item one. The lift costs petrol and the conversation we've been avoiding.

D238.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D238.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Pay for the repair in money, and for the silence in honesty.

D239.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D239.line: We are still on item one. I promised to carry a box, not whichever box you point at forever.

D239.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D239.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Yes, I said today; tomorrow wasn't included in those words.

D240.action: I move a new question to the bottom of the agenda.
D240.line: We are still on item one. Every little choice has brought us to this locked door.

D240.action: I hand out numbered speaking slips.
D240.line: Your interruption is item seven now. Remember saying nothing could go wrong? Look at what we're carrying now.
